title: Sign in
subtitle: Matches, value picks, parlays and the best odds, in one place.
sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
privateNote: Private access. If you need an account, ask the administrator.
forbiddenBody: Your account is not allowed to see this section.

steps.useRecovery: No phone? Use a recovery code
steps.useApp: Use the code from the app
steps.mfaSubtitle: Type the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…).
steps.enrollSubtitle: Your account needs it to sign in. It takes a minute and protects you even if someone knows your password.
steps.enrollStep1: Install Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
steps.enrollStep2: Press “Set up” and scan the QR code with the app.
steps.enrollStep3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
steps.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
steps.manualKey: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
steps.recoverySubtitle: If you lose your phone, each code lets you in once.
steps.recoveryWarning: They are shown only now. Keep them in a password manager or on paper, away from the phone.
steps.recoverySaved: I have stored them somewhere safe.
steps.passwordSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

account.activateSubtitle: Hello, {name}. Create your password to get into PrediGol.
account.inviteInvalid: This link no longer works: it expired, was used or was replaced by a newer one.
account.inviteRenewed: If the link was a pending invitation's, we sent you a new one. Check your inbox (and the spam folder).
account.alreadyActive: Already activated your account? Sign in
account.off: Activation by e-mail is not available right now. Ask the administrator for access.
account.rule: At least {min} characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
account.forgotSubtitle: Type your account's e-mail and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
account.forgotSent: If an account exists with that e-mail, we sent you a link. It expires in 30 minutes and works once. Check the spam folder too.
account.forgotOff: Recovery by e-mail is not available right now. Ask the administrator to reset your password.
account.resetSubtitle: Saving it signs you out everywhere; your two-step verification, if you use it, stays as it is.
account.resetMfa: Your account uses two-step verification: type the code from your app (or a recovery code) to confirm it is you.
account.resetDone: Done: your password changed and every session ended. Sign in with the new one.
account.resetInvalid: This link no longer works: it expired (it lasts 30 minutes), was used or was replaced by a newer one.
account.unlockBody: Your account waits for a while after several failed attempts. If it was you, unlock it now.
account.unlockDone: Account unlocked. You can sign in now.
account.unlockInvalid: This link no longer works: it expired (it lasts one hour) or was used.
account.askUnlock: Send me a link to unlock it
account.unlockSent: If the account exists and is locked, we sent you a link to unlock it. Check your inbox.
